title: Governor DeWine Celebrates Grand Opening of Royal Canin's New Manufacturing Facility in Preble County - Ohio Governor Mike DeWine (.gov)
summary: Governor DeWine Celebrates Grand Opening of Royal Canin's New Manufacturing Facility in Preble County Ohio Governor Mike DeWine (.gov)
ai_summary: Governor Mike DeWine celebrated the opening of Royal Canin's new manufacturing facility in Preble County. The event marked a new addition to the region's pet food production.
